emma_support: Hey @chris_eng — customer sees intermittent 401s on /v1/generate but says there is no trace token in their logs. Need the short, customer-friendly checklist we send for grabbing a trace token + minimal repro (curl/HAR/console).
chris_eng: Short version: 1) grab the HTTP header we add, 2) save a HAR from the browser or SDK logs from mobile, 3) send a minimal curl that reproduces the call + the trace token. I'll paste quick steps.
chris_eng: Console (hosted): Open Console -> Requests -> find the failed request -> expand -> copy "Correlation" (labelled "Correlation ID"). That's the token we need.
chris_eng: Web SDK: open DevTools -> Network -> select request -> look at Request Headers for "x-rd-trace" or "x-redwood-correlation". The SDK also logs: `Correlator: <token>` when debug=true.
chris_eng: Mobile SDKs: enable verbose logs (android: set REDWOOD_LOG=debug / iOS: set RWLogLevel=debug) and search the device logs for "correlator" or "correlation" — we emit `correlator=<token>` on send.
chris_eng: HAR capture: Chrome/Edge -> Network tab -> reproduce the request -> right click -> Save all as HAR with content. That includes headers and payload.
chris_eng: Minimal curl we ask customers to try/send (replace <TOKEN> with the Correlation ID you found):
```
curl -v https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "x-rd-trace: <TOKEN>" -d '{"input":"test","max_tokens":8}'
```
chris_eng: If they can't reproduce, ask them to run the same curl but add `-D -` to dump headers and paste that output. Also ask for the exact timestamp (UTC) when they saw the 401.
lee_sre: Add: if customer is on Dedicated/Private, include the region/cluster id (Console -> Account -> Clusters) and the model name + pinned version. That matters for routing.
lee_sre: For billing/auth issues specifically: ask for the API key prefix (first 4 chars) and whether the key was rotated recently. Do NOT ask them to paste the full key.
emma_support: Great — can we make this into a one-message checklist for customers? Short and copy-pasteable.
chris_eng: Sure — here's a compact ask you can DM them.
chris_eng: "Please send: 1) Correlation token (Console Requests -> Correlation or network header x-rd-trace), 2) HAR or mobile SDK logs showing the failing request, 3) Minimal curl that reproduces the call and the output of `curl -v` (or `-D -`), 4) UTC timestamp of failure, 5) API key prefix (first 4 chars) and cluster/region if on Dedicated/Private. If you can, toggle SDK debug logs and attach those"
emma_support: Nice. I'm going to DM the customer now.
support_bot: Created support ticket #INC-2024-778 and attached this thread. :white_check_mark:
emma_support: Thanks @chris_eng and @lee_sre — I'll request the HAR + curl output and the correlation token. Will follow up once they reply. :thumbsup:
